title: Etheria Waves
description: An add-on to the Etheria mod that reworks spell castng
body:
# Etheria Waves An add-on to the [**Etheria**](https://modrinth.com/mod/etheria) mod that reworks spell casting replacing the usual hud with a menu for hand-drawing symbols corresponding to spells you want to cast.
## **Waring** All the ususal limits on casting spells still apply(ex. being limited to your element, having to put spells into spell slots to cast). If you wish to disable them use unlimitedSpells ## New pages to the spell description! See the symbol needed to cast the spell when viewing the spell description and practice drawing it there! ![An example of a spell symbol](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/MsZ254Af/images/d95b538e83d4949af25bb0e512751308701e0aa4.png)
